You're talking to the Shipyard demo model — a built-in stub, so no real provider was billed. In a live deployment this request would be paid from your connected wallet (UsePod balance or x402 USDC), routed to the cheapest capable model, and metered to the token.

You said: "What can Shipyard Inference do?"

Notice the chips under this reply: which model ran, the token count, what it cost, and what you saved versus calling the baseline model direct.
